out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Felt he left his body and existed outside it; later viewed his body/brain from inside the brain (“in the very middle of my brain”). Also reported awareness of loved ones “on the other side of the world.”
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Heavy vibrations rising from toes; peeling away “like Velcro… or chicken meat being pulled from the bone”; jaw/tongue relaxed; then felt weightless and fully out of body.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A “swirling portal” that grew until it filled vision; later described a dark shape that enveloped him (not a physical tunnel) until he was “swallowed by it.”
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt a force stronger than gravity pulling/calling him deeper through space toward an edge/boundary.

arrival.other_being_detail: A gigantic bull “made of fire” in the dark void; later “thousands of voices”/a collective presence; later a recently deceased woman he recognized (friend’s mother).

environment.environment_other_detail: Multiple realms: (1) endless outer space with planets/galaxies and unfamiliar colors; (2) a “creamy milky-texture” white realm/source with kaleidoscopic mathematical patterns; (3) a thick black void of “100% nothing”; plus visions of other worlds including a planet with tall grass and a yak–orangutan-like animal.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug or medication overdose (uncertain life-threatening status) with severe chest pain; not taken to hospital; no diagnosis.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Unaffiliated atheist; stated he believed God and afterlife did not exist prior to the experience.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Fire-bull entity encountered in the void; detailed “brain interior” vision with honeycomb/cell-like structures and electrical pulses.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Portal/space travel → white source realm/boundary → falling into dark void → fire-bull guide and warning voice → return to white source with many voices → remote awareness/visiting loved ones and other worlds → “brain/body machine” demonstration and re-separation → encounter with recently deceased woman → abrupt physical return (vomit, jolting up).
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the white/source realm multiple times; repeated reluctance/return discussions.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported non-directional vision/seeing in all directions at once and “everything happening at once” regarding time.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Swirling colorful portal; creamy textured white “source” realm; fall into a thick black void of indifference; gigantic bull made of fire acting as a guide but warned against following; detailed internal view of brain as honeycomb-like cells and electrical pulses; cosmology described as a “slow drip” rather than a bang; visions of other planets and lifeforms.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You’re home now.” / “This is where you came from and this is where you’ll end.” / “Don’t follow him.” / “It feels stupid that I ever believed in time.” / “It was like being bathed in melting wax, but without it ever sticking to you.”
